---
title: "Figure 1 actual-size print proof"
format: html
editor: source
---

Readability trial at 180 x 250 mm. No data or statistical changes. Frozen
versions remain unchanged. All MAG tips, viral-tree nodes and network edges are
retained; only text density changes. Full taxonomy key is an accompanying S3
candidate. S1 stays experimental design/workflow and S2 the test overview.

```{r}
lib<-Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_METACODER_LIB");if(nzchar(lib)).libPaths(c(lib,.libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table);library(ggplot2);library(grid);library(ggrepel);library(patchwork)})
out<-commandArgs(TRUE)[1];stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
root<-"/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
frozen<-file.path(root,"figure1_shared_taxonomy_2026-09-14-v3")
paths<-c(mag=file.path(root,"mag_heat_tree_circular_quality_2026-09-13-v3/source/native_mag_quality_tree.rds"),
 viral=file.path(root,"native_metacoder_heat_trees_2026-09-13-v4/source/votu_native_heat_tree.rds"),
 nodes=file.path(frozen,"tables/recoloured_tree_nodes.tsv"),key=file.path(frozen,"tables/shared_taxonomy_key.tsv"),
 alignment=file.path(frozen,"tables/MAG_colour_alignment.tsv"),profile=file.path(frozen,"tables/deepest_taxonomy_profile.tsv"),
 edges=file.path(frozen,"tables/plotted_network_edges.tsv"),network_nodes=file.path(frozen,"tables/circular_network_nodes.tsv"),
 quality=file.path(frozen,"tables/viral_node_quality.tsv"),
 trajectories=file.path(root,"figure1_expanded_2026-09-14-v2/tables/selected_trajectories.tsv"),
 labels=file.path(root,"figure1_expanded_2026-09-14-v2/tables/trajectory_labels_and_colours.tsv"))
hash<-function(p)digest::digest(file=p,algo="sha256");before<-vapply(paths,hash,character(1))
mag<-readRDS(paths['mag']);viral<-readRDS(paths['viral']);nodes<-fread(paths['nodes']);key<-fread(paths['key'])
alignment<-fread(paths['alignment']);d<-fread(paths['profile']);edges<-fread(paths['edges']);nd<-fread(paths['network_nodes']);q<-fread(paths['quality'])
d[,sample_label:=factor(sample_label,levels=c("C1-I","C1-B","C2-I","C2-B","C3-I","C3-B"))]
d[,condition_label:=factor(as.character(condition_label),levels=c("Control","Phage-UV"),labels=c("Control","Treatment"))]
stopifnot(!anyNA(d$condition_label))
d[,display_category:=factor(display_category,levels=rev(key$display_category))]
stopifnot(!anyNA(d$sample_label),all(abs(d[,sum(relative_abundance),by=sample_title]$V1-1)<1e-10))
z<-mag$layers[[1]]$data;m<-match(sub("_(edge|node)$","",as.character(z$group)),nodes$node_id)
z$color[!is.na(m)]<-nodes$colour[m[!is.na(m)]];mag$layers[[1]]$data<-z;mag$layers[[1]]$aes_params[[1]]<-z$color
clean_tree<-function(p,pattern) {
 lab<-as.data.table(copy(p$layers[[10]]$data))
 lab<-lab[group=="nodes" & grepl(pattern,label)]
 lab[,`:=`(x=(xmin+xmax)/2,y=(ymin+ymax)/2)]
 lab[,label:=sub("\\\\n.*$","",label)]
 lab[,label:=sub(" sp[0-9]+[*]?","",label)]
 # Retain one polygon layer plus the existing MAG QC layers. Native text
 # layers are replaced with physical 7-point text.
 retain<-which(!vapply(p$layers,function(l)is.data.frame(l$data)&&"label"%in%names(l$data),logical(1)))
 p$layers<-p$layers[retain]
 for(i in seq_along(p$layers)) {
   dat<-p$layers[[i]]$data
   if(is.data.frame(dat)&&"group"%in%names(dat)) {
     keep<-!grepl("legend",dat$group)
     for(k in names(p$layers[[i]]$aes_params))if(length(p$layers[[i]]$aes_params[[k]])==nrow(dat))p$layers[[i]]$aes_params[[k]]<-p$layers[[i]]$aes_params[[k]][keep]
     p$layers[[i]]$data<-dat[keep,]
   }
 }
 for(axis in c("x","y")){s<-p$scales$get_scales(axis);s$limits<-NULL}
 p$coordinates$limits$x<-c(-.07,1.07);p$coordinates$limits$y<-c(-.07,1.07)
 p<-p+geom_text_repel(data=lab,aes(x,y,label=label),inherit.aes=FALSE,size=7/ggplot2::.pt,
   seed=42,min.segment.length=0,max.overlaps=Inf,box.padding=.25,colour="#222222")+
   theme(legend.position="none",plot.margin=margin(2,2,2,2))
 list(plot=p,labels=lab)
}
M<-clean_tree(mag,"^p_(Bacteroidota|Chloroflexota|Pseudomonadota)|^s_(CAJATL01|SHND01)")
V<-clean_tree(viral,"^(Unclassified|c_Caudoviricetes|f_Ped)|^.*Riboviria")
# Give taxonomic branches a visible outline without changing topology or node area.
vz<-V$plot$layers[[1]]$data
V$plot$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour<-ifelse(grepl("_edge$",vz$group),vz$color,NA)
V$plot$layers[[1]]$aes_params$linewidth<-.13
base<-theme_classic(base_size=7)+theme(axis.text=element_text(size=7),axis.title=element_text(size=7),
 plot.title=element_text(size=7),plot.subtitle=element_text(size=7),legend.position="none",plot.margin=margin(3,3,3,3))
bars<-ggplot(d,aes(sample_label,relative_abundance,fill=display_category))+geom_col(width=.6)+
 scale_fill_manual(values=setNames(key$colour,key$display_category))+
 facet_grid(condition_label~.)+scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::label_percent(),breaks=c(0,.5,1),expand=c(0,0))+
 labs(x="Cycle - phase",y="MAG-mapped reads (%)")+base+
 theme(strip.text=element_text(size=7),strip.background=element_rect(fill="#F5F5F5",colour=NA),panel.spacing.y=unit(4,"mm"))
hp<-nd[type=="MAG"];vp<-nd[type=="Viral contig"]
hp[,colour:=alignment$colour[match(id,alignment$MAG_ID)]]
e<-merge(edges,hp[,.(MAG_ID=id,x,y)],by="MAG_ID")
e<-merge(e,vp[,.(phage_id=id,xend=x,yend=y)],by="phage_id")
curves<-rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(e)),function(i){t<-seq(0,1,length.out=45);r<-e[i];data.table(edge=i,
 x=(1-t)^2*r$x+2*(1-t)*t*.18*(r$x+r$xend)/2+t^2*r$xend,
 y=(1-t)^2*r$y+2*(1-t)*t*.18*(r$y+r$yend)/2+t^2*r$yend,response=r$response_state,hits=r$n_hits)}))
vp[,completeness:=q$completeness[match(id,q$phage_id)]]
vp[,realm:=edges$realm_display[match(id,edges$phage_id)]]
hp[,degree:=edges[, .N,by=MAG_ID]$N[match(id,edges[, .N,by=MAG_ID]$MAG_ID)]]
labels<-hp[order(-degree,id)][1:3]
labels[,label:=sub("_MAGScoT_cleanbin_0*","/",id)]
network<-ggplot()+geom_path(data=curves,aes(x,y,group=edge,colour=response,linewidth=hits),alpha=.5)+
 scale_colour_manual(values=c("Control higher"="#8FCB8A","Not supported"="#B0B7BD","Phage-UV higher"="#7E57C2"))+
 scale_linewidth_continuous(trans="log1p",range=c(.1,.6))+
 geom_point(data=hp,aes(x,y),shape=21,size=1.3,stroke=.15,fill=hp$colour)+
 geom_point(data=vp,aes(x,y,fill=completeness,shape=realm),size=1.3,stroke=.15)+
 scale_shape_manual(values=c(Duplodnaviria=23,Unclassified=25))+
 scale_fill_gradientn(colours=c("#FFF4C7","#E8B46D","#B57133","#593214"),limits=c(0,100),trans="sqrt",na.value="#D5D9DD")+
 geom_text_repel(data=labels,aes(x,y,label=label),size=7/ggplot2::.pt,seed=42,nudge_x=-.2,min.segment.length=0,max.overlaps=Inf)+
 coord_equal(xlim=c(-1.3,1.2),ylim=c(-1.15,1.15),clip="off")+theme_void()+theme(legend.position="none",plot.margin=margin(3,3,3,3))
traj<-fread(paths['trajectories']);tl<-fread(paths['labels'])
radial_path<-Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_RADIAL_NETWORK_RDS")
if(nzchar(radial_path)){
 network<-readRDS(radial_path)+theme(legend.position="none")+labs(caption=NULL)
 # Fit-test only: scale the complete 300mm-wide detail into the 86.4mm slot.
 # The resulting host labels are about 2pt, intentionally exposing the limit.
 for(i in seq_along(network$layers))for(k in c("size","linewidth","stroke"))
   if(!is.null(network$layers[[i]]$aes_params[[k]]))network$layers[[i]]$aes_params[[k]]<-network$layers[[i]]$aes_params[[k]]*.288
}
traj[,condition:=factor(condition,levels=c("control","treatment"))];traj[,phase:=factor(phase,levels=c("initial","backflush"))]
one<-function(id) {
 a<-traj[feature_id==id];k<-tl[feature_id==id]
 short<-if(k$community=="MAGs")sub("_MAGScoT_cleanbin_0*","/",id) else sub("_coassembly_megahit_.*_contig_k141_","/",id)
 title<-if(k$community=="MAGs")paste(short,sub("^.__","",k$taxonomy),sep="\n") else short
 ggplot(a,aes(cycle,normalized_count,colour=condition,shape=phase,linetype=phase,group=interaction(condition,phase)))+
 geom_line(linewidth=.35)+geom_point(size=1.3)+
 scale_colour_manual(values=c(control="#8FCB8A",treatment="#7E57C2"))+
 scale_shape_manual(values=c(initial=16,backflush=17))+scale_linetype_manual(values=c(initial="solid",backflush="dashed"))+
 scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:3)+scale_y_continuous(trans=scales::pseudo_log_trans(base=10),
 breaks=range(a$normalized_count),labels=scales::label_number(accuracy=1,scale_cut=scales::cut_short_scale()))+
 labs(title=title,x="Cycle",y=NULL)+base
}
E<-wrap_plots(lapply(tl[community=="MAGs",feature_id],one),ncol=1)
F<-wrap_plots(lapply(tl[community=="vOTUs",feature_id],one),ncol=2)
stopifnot(nrow(hp)==80,nrow(vp)==85,nrow(edges)==86,nrow(traj)==72,
 all(hp$colour==alignment$bar_colour[match(hp$id,alignment$MAG_ID)]))
dir.create(file.path(out,"figures"),recursive=TRUE);dir.create(file.path(out,"tables"));dir.create(file.path(out,"source"))
saveRDS(list(M=M$plot,V=V$plot,bars=bars,E=E,F=F,key=key,mag=mag),file.path(out,"source/review_panels.rds"))
pdf(file.path(out,"figures/figure1-print-proof.pdf"),width=180/25.4,height=300/25.4,useDingbats=FALSE)

draw(bars,.25,.601,.48,.20);draw(network,.745,.61,.48,.205)

for(i in 1:4)grid.text(LETTERS[i],x=c(.01,.56,.01,.51)[i],y=c(.99,.99,.707,.707)[i],just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=9,fontface="bold"))
for(i in 1:6)grid.text(LETTERS[i+4],x=c(.01,.34,.67)[(i-1)%%3+1],y=if(i<=3).437 else .32,just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=9,fontface="bold"))
grid.text("Node area: mean relative abundance (%)",x=.76,y=.724,gp=gpar(fontsize=7))
draw_scale<-function(x,y,w,title,palette,labels) {
  cs<-palette(seq(0,1,length.out=40))
  for(i in seq_along(cs))grid.rect(x=x-w/2+w*(i-.5)/40,y=y,width=w/40,height=.005,gp=gpar(fill=cs[i],col=NA))
  grid.text(title,x=x,y=y+.013,gp=gpar(fontsize=7))
  grid.text(labels,x=seq(x-w/2,x+w/2,length.out=length(labels)),y=y-.011,gp=gpar(fontsize=7))
}
draw_scale(.145,.724,.20,"A: completeness (%)",mag$scales$get_scales("fill_ggnewscale_1")$palette,c("75","100"))

for(i in 1:2){xx<-c(.53,.74)[i];grid.lines(x=c(xx,xx+.045),y=rep(.194,2),gp=gpar(col="#333333",lwd=1,lty=i));grid.points(xx+.022,.194,default.units="npc",pch=c(16,17)[i],size=unit(1.2,"mm"));grid.text(c("Initial","Backflush")[i],x=xx+.054,y=.194,just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=7))}
# Complete common key: all 70 categories, no omitted or remapped taxon colours.
grid.text("A, C, D: shared prokaryotic taxonomy",x=.015,y=.173,just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=7,fontface="bold"))
key[,short_label:=gsub(" \\[unresolved\\]"," *",gsub(" \\[remainder\\]"," +",display_category))]
nr<-ceiling(nrow(key)/4)

 grid.rect(x=xx,y=yy,width=.009,height=.0045,gp=gpar(fill=key$colour[i],col=NA))
 grid.text(key$short_label[i],x=xx+.009,y=yy,just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=7))}

# A separate readable shared colour key, rather than 70 tiny labels in the main.

grid.newpage();grid.text("Supplementary Figure 3 | Shared prokaryotic colour key",x=.03,y=.97,just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=10,fontface="bold"))
for(i in seq_len(nrow(key))) {
 col<-if(i<=ceiling(nrow(key)/2))0 else 1;row<-(i-1)%%ceiling(nrow(key)/2)
 grid.rect(x=.04+.49*col,y=.92-row*.023,width=.013,height=.009,gp=gpar(fill=key$colour[i],col=NA))
 grid.text(key$display_category[i],x=.055+.49*col,y=.92-row*.023,just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=7))
}
grid.text("Identical colours in MAG tips, stacked bars and network MAG nodes.\nUnresolved = no deeper reported assignment; remainder = other assignments in that phylum.",
 x=.03,y=.065,just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=7))
dev.off()
fwrite(M$labels,file.path(out,"tables/main_MAG_tree_labels.tsv"),sep="\t");fwrite(V$labels,file.path(out,"tables/main_viral_tree_labels.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(labels,file.path(out,"tables/main_network_labels.tsv"),sep="\t")
writeLines(c("Actual-size trial: 180 x 250 mm. Text 7pt minimum; panel letters9pt. Not author-approved.",
 "All data and colour assignments retained. Tree labels selectively retained for readability; network labels are the three highest-degree hosts (ID tie break). Full labels remain in frozen source artwork/tables.",
 "S1 experimental design/workflow; S2 full abundance-test overview; S3 full shared taxonomy key.",
 "E-F are the same two MAGs/four vOTUs selected by archived BH thresholds. No refits. Connecting lines not fitted predictions. Independent pseudo-log y axes; normalized sequencing counts not cells.",
 "Print at 100%, no Fit to Page. This PDF is already 180mm wide.",
 "Network: MAG circles and viral diamond/triangle nodes. Viral fill is completeness (sqrt spacing), grey unavailable; diamond Duplodnaviria, triangle unclassified realm. Edges: green down in treatment host expression, purple up in treatment, grey unsupported; width is reported link count, not confidence. Node positions are layout, not ecology distances.",
 "MAG QC: completeness inner ring, contamination outer ring. Phylum/descendant shades unchanged. Tree nodes sized by within-community mean abundance; physical node sizes across differently sized panels are not directly comparable."),file.path(out,"PRINT_REVIEW.txt"))
file.copy(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH"),file.path(out,"source/figure1_print_proof.qmd"))
stopifnot(identical(before,vapply(paths,hash,character(1))))
fwrite(data.table(path=paths,sha256=before),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
files<-list.files(out,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(path=substring(files,nchar(out)+2),sha256=vapply(files,hash,character(1))),file.path(out,"output_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
cat("PASS: source hashes unchanged; all nodes/edges/trajectories retained; review canvas 180x300mm\n")
```
